conventions: TypeScript strict mode with React 18 and Jest (@testing-library/react); format with Prettier (single quotes, trailing commas) and lint with ESLint.
Use Jest expect matchers and React Testing Library screen queries (getByText) and act(...) as established in packages/frontend-app-api/src/wiring/createSpecializedApp.test.tsx.
Preserve the existing Apache 2.0 license header and copyright year on existing files.

decisions.topic: Post-finalization render count assertion in root-element route-ref test
decisions.reason: An upper bound of at most 3 accommodates the 3 deterministic renders across bootstrap, rerender, and route-resolution update while still failing if a render loop occurs.
